Which mark earns the name?

Twenty concepts. One final identity.

The ranking favors immediate software-house recognition, distinctiveness, small-size clarity and the ability to represent a complete ERP rather than a single feature.

How the priority was decided

First-glance meaningDoes it signal software-house operations without explanation?
Ownable silhouetteCan the shape be recognized and protected?
Product scalabilityDoes it survive as a favicon, app icon and navigation mark?
Long-term rangeCan it represent delivery, people, clients and finance together?

Recommended synthesis

Do not merge shapes. Merge the strongest ideas.

The final logo should not become a collage. Use one primary silhouette, then borrow the best strategic qualities from the other leaders.

Primary symbol: #01

CodeBase structure

Developer brackets, an H spine and a firm base create the clearest category signal.

Behavior: #02

Command confidence

Make the mark feel active and operator-led, not passive or corporate.

Typography: #03

House / Base wordmark

Use a visible hinge between the two words to clarify the brand architecture.

Story: #04

Work becomes value

The identity system should show the path from delivery activity to financial truth.
